skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have basic knowledge about comparative law science and deep understanding of the characteristics of major legal systems around the world.
Students can analyze the factors affecting the formation and development of legal systems, evaluate and analyze the reasons for similarities and differences between legal systems.
Students develop research skills, independent work skills, teamwork skills, and presentation skills.
Students can analyze legal solutions from different legal systems to make decisions on applying appropriate solutions to emerging legal issues.
Students form an attitude of active and independent scientific research, propose research topics, and solve scientific legal problems.
